text: Great product, reasonable price. Arrived quickly!
The product arrived when expected and installation was simple.

The 1st time I bought this cartridge, I was replacing the one that came with my new refrigerator. I took the cartridge that came with the fridge out with no problem and inserted yours. So when it was time to replace it again, we rebought your cartridge, but when we tried to remove your old one, we nearly had to take the refrigerator apart!! It just wouldn't come out!I thought we were going to have to call a repairman. We were finally able to take the section apart that the cartridge sits into remove it. We went ahead & put your new one in since we already had it apart. I can only hope when it's time to change this one, we don't experience the same problem!!!! The cartridge seemed to do its proper function once it was installed.

Used for the first time this morning (forgot I had no coffee beans). Got them ground to "sea salt" coarse as recommended.  Very easy to use, LOVE that no grounds made it through the incredibly fine filter.  It bubbled up just like the guys said it would and made a stellar cup of coffee.  Now, I just need to try it iced!

I like collecting mugs from various various vacations - a practice that often proved problematic when I use them because the tops of souvineer mugs are often oversized and/or irregular. I can't count the number of times I've stepped away from a steeping mug only to return to coffee grounds sprayed all about the kitchen, thanks to poorly-executed precarious placement of a unbalanced, undersized plastic filter.

The rubber, oversized bottom of this device fills me with confidence. I've used it on my most troublesome mugs and it didn't shift at all. Wonderful. The only think I'd change - add really - is the handle nub gets a little hot. A silicone coating on that would be nice, but I can certainly live without it.
I wish the water did not pour so quickly through the hole.  If the hole was smaller, the water would go through more slowly and the coffee would be stronger.

We bought this item as a gift and were truly impressed with every aspect of the Pour Over Coffee Brewer and its packaging. The brewer looks sleek and well-built. The attractive box and clear instructions inside are evidence of a high quality product thoughtfully designed and beautifully presented. It made a wonderful gift and was very well received. We'll buy again from The Elan Collective.
Excellent product! 5 stars.
Well made, makes a great cup of coffee.

These guys have raised the pour over bar!  I've used scores of brewing techniques, I roast my own beans, and I must say that this little filter is truly remarkable.  I've been using a Kalita filter for a single cup brew for about a year now and while I won't put it away, this filter is leagues above the Kalita.  They should win a design award.

Very easy of use! It works just as it says it does, nothing complicated. And it is very easy to clean, just pour water on it, all the coffee grinds disappear, and it is ready for the next cup. The taste of the cup of coffee it delivers is very tasty. I recommend it!
Well made and works perfectly.  After a week of daily use, I am very happy with it.

High quality and perfect for my morning pour-over.  The base allows for a variety of cup sizes. Very easy to see below the base to determine the liquid level in the cup or mug you are using. It is perfect for my YETI tumbler.  Extremely easy to clean and it looks nice sitting on the counter next to my coffee grinder.  I prefer a very strong cup of coffee so I grind my beans a little finer than recommended.  Flow through rate is still very acceptable and the end result is my perfect cup of coffee.  I would highly recommend to those who want more control over the end product in their cup and would like to get away from a traditional brewer or a pod machine.  One key, to the perfect cup of coffee, is to remember to let the coffee "bloom" for 30-60 seconds when you start your pour-over.  Well worth the money.

This filter coffeemaker is great.  I adjusted  my coffee grind to a bit finer adjustment, and the coffee improved;  while it's taken some getting used to, it's reliable, and makes great coffee!  And the card with brewing instructions is a great feature!

I've long been a fan of the pour-over method of coffee brewing because of its simplicity and practicality. This takes takes it up a notch by avoiding both plastic and paper. The hot water pours through a fine, stainless steel mesh. It may pour through too fast for some. I found, though, that this issue can be solved easily by using a finer grind of coffee, more like an espresso grind. That works well for my taste. It cleans easily, too.
We've tried mesh filters before - this is the first one that works perfectly - no more paper filters!

An excellent item that I can easily recommend. My morning brew has never tasted better. More of the coffee's flavor and intrinsic character is ending up in each cup. I used disposable Melitta unbleached paper cones to prepare my coffee for many years.

This coffeemaker is just what I was looking for!  I go RV camping with friends and they make instant coffee--which I just can't drink.  Now I bring my coffeemaker and ground coffee and enjoy a freshly brewed cup of coffee whenever I want to.  A great buy at a great price.
Great way to brew your own coffee at the office.
I would like a larger capacity filter to handle a liter size coffee thermos.
I could add as much coffee grounds and hot water to make a Perfect Cup of Coffee!
It's my first experience with filter free pour over product, I think it's amazing idea to eliminate the paper filters and it can fit on almost everything from a cup to chemex glass.
I loved this at first. However, now 3 months later it does not work well. It gets clogged easily even with cleaning after each use. I have wasted a lot of coffee because it will not drip.
beautifully designed and intuitively constructed--not a loose wire and fits securely on alll sizes. Especially like the gripper for the cup connection. Pretty lines!

This makes the best coffee and its very easy to use.  Coffee is rich and great brewed and the "pour over" fits great over my mug.  Its nice to be able to make a single cup without having to make an entire pot.  Highly recommend

Here's the email we wrote to the company. Hope it helps you, too:
"Thanks for your email - great communication!
To help you in your new collaboration, we spent some time researching these on Amazon. We liked that you seemed to have done your research and were thoughtful in your design. It arrived today (wow, fast - on a Sunday!) and we are making some coffee as I type this. We like the design - nice look, clean, and solid. To give you some background, we have been drip brewing our coffee by the cup for quite a while, but were just using regular strainers that dipped into the cup. It's an inexpensive option and has worked well enough for us. We were about to buy another, when our search on Amazon brought up many similar to yours, and it made sense to buy something designed for making coffee specifically.
Why did we choose yours over the competition? We liked that you seemed like real people and cared about a quality design and quality customer service. Other factors important to us were: where was it made and how much did it cost? It seems all of these are made in China - at least our search didn't come up with any other options. If we had found one made in USA, I admit that likely would have swayed us away from yours. You didn't hide that it was made in China and even provided an explanation. Also, yours seemed a little more expensive to us, but we hope that the quality makes up for the difference and that we won't have to replace it for many years to come.
Fantastic brew technique
Excellent quality and smooth coffee flavor.
It does not let enough of the water thru the grinds. I own a coffee shop and this cant be used to make pour overs.

This product is well made and easy to use.  I have only used it once so far, so I cannot review how well it works for brewing a "great" cup of coffee over a traditional brew method.  Will keep experimenting and update.
GREAT

LOVE IT!  I cheat, and use a coffee filter too - I am pretty cognizant of coffee oils and try to lessen.  You don't have to, but I do.  I wanted a better way than nasty land fill producing Keurig's - now I have it.  Thanks so much!

Completely satisfied with this pour over.  It is working better than I expected, no mud in my coffee anymore and the taste is still comparable to french press, my brew method of choice.  I will order more to keep one at work and one in the car for road trips.
great dripper!  easy to clean

Great pour over coffee dripper.  Works well.  With any of these you need to watch how fine the grind is of the coffee.  This unit works very well but you do need to run it through the dishwasher regularly when using a finely ground java.  A course grade allows the flow to easily drip through, but with that diminish that java flavor we all crave.  Best thing to do with the unit is to clean it every week (depending on how much you use it)  If I somehow wear this out, I'd buy another (cant see how with regular maintenance)  I prefer to satisfy my java fix at home rather than buy at the local coffee shop and this unit certainly helps with that.

Love this pour over brewer! Stayed in a small cabin over Christmas that only had a microwave, so I took along mugs and ground coffee and we were able to have our morning brew before heading our to visit family.
Love the taste of the coffee (better than from the coffee machine) and it is easy to clean
I bought this to begin my pour over journey and I'm so glad! This device is so easy to use and works perfectly - every time.
Drips to slow. Tried different grinds but drips to slow. Try another brand.
love this filter and not worrying about paper filters. It work great and the coffee tasted much better.

I have received my new Panda Portable washing machine and am both thrilled and sad at the same time. My Panda did an great job of washing the clothes (made me happy) but did a better job than my $1000+ washing machine in my home (made me sad). I wanted to test it before we placed it in our motorhome. So far it works much better than I had hoped for.

I will keep everyone posted!

I was so excited to see a larger version of the panda washer. As soon as I could I ordered one. It was delivered in 3 days! and I got it set up in less than 5 min in my bathroom. It looks very nice in person. I've already did a few loads to test out how well it works and I couldn't be more pleased. It cleans way better than my apartment building washer and the much larger spin side, gets the clothing almost dry. So far I'm very happy with me purchase.

The unit is solid....I have run it for 10 days and a dozen loads. However, it knots everything up. With the knotting up, it doesn't rinse effectively......if they added a center pole to it, it would make this product almost perfect.

Update-It has been over six months. This is literally the worst purchase decision I have ever made. The unit works as it is supposed to, meaning the washer moves and the spinner spins. The tube that is supposed to connect to the fill port doesn't fit. When you run a load, it will beat your clothes up to the point of destroying the threads. Takes six or seven rinse fills to get rid of just a table spoon of detergent, and Yes, I have made so many attempts at the correct amount of detergent. This system is just more of a pain than loading everything up and spending an hour at the laundromat........I just finished a load of jeans and a load of socks and shirts.....It literally took six hours for two small loads.....Do not buy this product.

I wouldn't give this product away as I like my friends more than that.

I originally had a bit of problem with my delivery but the customer service was wonderful and straightened everything out promptly.  I am so happy with my new Panda. It's great. Washes my clothese cleaner than the public laundromat washing machines.  I can wash and rinse as many times as I want. For me... it's a blessing  (:

This is the second machine. Someone deleted my first review of the first one which was shipped and arrived with box torn up and the base completely broken off along with a few other minor issues.
The replacement just arrived today and it's in great shape (Yay!!) and appears to work well but I have yet to run it with clothes in it. I'm excited :) and will update after using it a few times. :) If it works well I will give it 5 stars.
REALLY glad I ordered a replacement. I was really stressed about how to get this big of an item back to where it came from but Amazon was just great, they made it really easy. So glad I bought it through them!

I've had one of these types in Belize, where they're normal.  I absolutely love this machine, takes about 10 minutes to dry your clothes on a line after the spin, even indoors, with NO DRIPS.  The stuff comes out of there sort of vaguely damp.  Everyone should have one of these.  I noticed SUCH a difference when I came back to the States and had to use a regular washer at the laundry-mat.  I MISSED my Belizean style machine--really made in China, but all Belizeans use these.  This one is top of the line, lightweight, and even has a pump.  My Belizean machine did not.  Clothes come out so super dry, it's amazing.  Not heat dry, but centrifugal, so you drape them over something and they're dry so quick or throw them in the dryer for a few minutes, which is nice as long as you're not shoving quarters to dry each load.  With this one, I throw in three loads for $1.50 in the dryer and comes out perfect.  I could probably throw in four or five, but didn't have that much wash to do.  Is a BIT time consuming in that you have to pay attention to it and shift the loads into the spin, put them back, rinse, spin again, but I love this machine.  Uses a regular plug-in.  All in all, it's still 40 minutes per wash cycle, but you gotta be on top of it.  In my opinion, clothes come out cleaner.  We got it because of a new baby and a lack of infinite quarters.  Love it.  Get one. For what it's worth, I live on the coast of Washington State in case climate is a consideration.  Used one in Beliz

UPDATE: This stopped working in less than a year. It also started leaking a few months into using it. I am researching what to do next since there is a one year warranty. It seems as though I need to send the whole thing back which is a pain because it is HEAVY. No one from Panda is responding to me. I think the motor just quit and maybe I can replace it myself? I don't feel like I have even used it that much to have it die on me in less than a year. vERY DISAPPOINTED.

This is a lifesaver! Best investment I've made for my apartment. I live on the fourth floor in a walk up walk up and the laundry room is in the basement. The building is over 100 years old so there aren't any washer/dryer hookups. This has saved me so much time and many exhausting trips. I firmly believe this cleans my clothes better than a regular washing machine. It is easy to use and doesn't take up much space, although it's a lot taller than I expected. I got the largest unit and I push it up against my kitchen sink and it works like a charm. I was able to wash my queen size comforter by itself without a problem. I can also wash my queen size sheets, pillow cases with a few T-shirts in one load. (mind you, the comforter is on the thin side)
The spinner is amazing! I only have to spin things for a minute or two and they come out almost fully dry. I cannot believe I didn't get one of these sooner. I absolutely love to do laundry now.

This is an amazing washer to have if you live in an apartment. The only noise it makes is shaking from the water being sloshed around while it washes your clothes. However that is a small price to pay for clean clothes with no laundromat!

This is a great little unit for the price. And this was the first time I've used anything of this class, so this is a review for anyone who's used to using a normal washer and dryer and getting this for other purposes, like using in a studio room where you don't have connections.

First let me mention the function of this is not fully automatic. You have to add your clothes, then add your water. I used a very small amount of laundry detergent. Set it for 15 minutes and it did agitation cycles for 15 minutes. Then you have to select drain and drain all the water. Next you have to refill the tub with fresh water to do the rinse. Set it for another 15 minutes, then drain that water. Then you can transfer your laundry to the spin dryer. The spin dryer is essentially just the spin cycle on a larger washing machine. So, this is NOT REALLY a dryer, just a spin cycle. Your clothes will be close to dry and can be hung or, as I chose to do, get a warm air drying rack. I got a decent one for $84 that has hangers and a cloth housing that directs all the warm air through the laundry.

Bottom line is that this unit is great and does its job, but still requires your involvement and time. You can't just throw laundry in and come back to clean laundry. On a positive note, I have exceptional control on how the cycles work and how many times I want to rinse my clothes and how exact I want my water temp, etc. This unit can manage for 1 person, not a family.

I got my machine today, and I am SO HAPPY!!! It fita perfectly in my hall way, and though the chord and hoses are short, they're totally something I can work with. I caught up on all my laundry today, the only thing I had to do is bring the towels to the laundronat for drying, only because my 860 sq. ft. Apartment didn't have enough space for hanging towels dry.

Agitation cycle, awesome. Rinse cycle, awesome. Spin cycle, INCREDIBLE.

I am so happy to own this machine. 2 thumbs WAY up!

I had the small panda washer. I loved it, but I wanted a machine to wash everything. I wanted to wash blankets and sleeping bags, without having to go out to the laundry mat. I am very pleased with the largest size. I must admit, it has a very different feel than the smaller one. I am glad I made the purchase.

Update-This machine broke down with the spin cycle. So that is about 3-4 months.
Amazon more than refunded my money that the company did not. I'm not sure why the company did not give a full refund. I have had prior business with them before. I would deal with another company if I could find one that sold these machines on Amazon.
How is this portable without castors? When EMPTY it's light enough to be dragged, but that can't be a good thing for it or the floor.

I'very got this Panda Washer on my birthday.  I use it the ONLY problem that the end of the water hose that goes to the end of the machine toward to the faucet is Not  stable.  I don't have any problem connecting the other end to the faucet it FIT perfectly is the end that goes to fill up the washer.  Is there a way  to attach it in that end. Thank you.
I do love the machine but after just a couple of months it broke down i contact the seller. And the seller was super nice they send me a new one and let me keep the old one

I love this Panda, BUT, it has been a learning experience. That being said, I want to thank the person who wrote in about using the expanding hose. (the hose that comes with, just throw it away JUNK). Turns out that the hose has a sort of valve thing. Unscrew that off and its the perfect size to fit the Panda incoming water slot on the machine.
[...]
And also with that paired with this:
[...]
One end permanently goes on my sink and the other is on the hose. Can't tell anything is different with the sink, just nozzle a tiny bit longer. The hose just snaps right on my sink.
Now I said it was a learning experience. Here are the things that I've have learned.
I tape the hose a little by nozzle entering the Panda. That way I know it wont just fly off and spray water everywhere in my kitchen.
On the drain hose, I've tied an old sock of which I made small holes in. So much lint comes out while draining didn't want that to clog sink. Works good.
And I did purchase a floating lint thing. That keeps the lint off my clothes.
When I'm done with the machine, I tie a rag on end of drain hose to capture any water that may not have drained out.
And I place a nice think rug under machine while in use. It soaks up any excess water and also acts like a buffer between machine and floor during spinning.
And yes it spins them well but they are not dry by any means, so I place semi wet clothing on hangers until completely dry.
I absolutely love my Panda washing machine, it gets my clothes really clean and it is easy to use as well. I highly recommend this washing machine!!
Great machine. Does a surprising amount of wash in one load (we bought the larger capacity one ). The spin cycle is awesome - clothes come out just barely damp.

Ordered several other brands from Amazon, had to return, one didn't wark at all the other one was totally useless. This one is just awesome, yes you do have to rinse few times and yes, you do have to do some things manually, but it's just great, capacity is perfect, washing quality is great. Just got it yesterday but very happy with it so far.

Good machine. Only downfall is the spin dryer,it seems like you can only put one item in there or else it's gets off balance and bangs loudly against the sides. I've had to repeatedly stop the machine move around the clothes and start it again until it got perfectly balanced. It's a real time consumer. I had to buy a separate stand up dryer to dry my clothes because the spin dryer wasn't working well.

I used this for a load of kitchen towels and two outfits.  This machine is remarkable.  Very happy that I bought it.  Now I can take it camping with us and it will fit perfectly in our camper.  No more wasting money on dirty coin operated machines!  The spinner works so well that my daughters jean shorts only took 15 minutes to be perfectly dry hanging outside.
washes great.
Difficult to manage
Works just like advertised. this can handle more clothes than you think. It seems to be well constructed and does a good job washing.

very good product, drier does not completely dry the clothes, however its as expected.
very good for the price.
no water leakage so far.
easy to move around and change location.
way better than having to use the Laundromat !!

I absolutely love this awesome machine I'm a mommy of three boys and a wife of a six foot man lol and it did an amazing job. It left my clothes extremely clean,I got the panda portable stand up dyer to pair it with and  I fell like I won the latto! Couldn't be happier.
Good, as described

Perfect for small loads. It has both washer and dryer components, and is easily portable. I have found that water tends to splash out of the washer when I do the maximum load, and it can get pretty loud when both the washer and dryer are running.
It worked well for 2 months but the spinner stopped working all of a sudden. The washer works but not the spinner. There is no proper support numbers or any help.

I loved it, thought it was the greatest thing ever - but after 7 months the spin dry side just stopped spinning. I've read that there is a one-year manufacturers warranty so I need to find out how I can redeem that.

If I can get it easily replaced I will update my rating.

This washer does a fantastic job, but I bought it less than 5 months ago and now when I put any water in it, it comes out the bottom.  The tub is cracked even though we've never over-filled it or placed anything heavy in it. I'm guessing the plastic tub is not strong enough to withstand temperature changes from wash to rinse

I love it!  We have the largest size and use it in an RV. It does take up some space so if you are in an RV think about where you will store it when not in use. It washes all our clothes which keeps us from the laundry mat and it does a better job than the laundry mat. Our clothes are brighter and whiter and I feel better knowing that just my things wash in that machine and not half of the neighborhood. You do have to move clothes from washing side to spinning side and it requires more attendance than a standard washer. If you understand that and it suits you and you have tight spaces then this machine is a must.

Purchase date: August 21, 2016. First review was posted around December 2016.

I've had this washer for a few months and run about 4 loads a week. It works great and gets clothes very clean. It's oddly fun to use. You just have to make sure not to overload the spin dryer and make sure it's balanced. The washer has paid for itself already--was spending $50 a month at laundry mat, so this is an awesome alternative.

UPDATE: July 24, 2017 The spin dryer has stopped draining. Most reviews of this washer say it stops working within a year and that has unfortunately proven true for me too! Overall it's great and in the long run saved me a lot of money and hassle, but I don't really want to have to buy a new washer each year. Thankfully, I'm moving to a new apartment where there's free laundry so I won't need the Panda anymore. It's great while it works, but don't expect it to last more than a year.

It has been over a month since I purchased this washer so I feel like I can leave a review. I have used it every weekend since purchasing to do anywhere from 5-8 loads of laundry. It is kind of loud, but my apartment is also tiny so I sit right next to it. No one has complained about noise though. I love how quick I feel like I get the laundry done, and the spinner gets the clothes very wrung out.

I ordered this washer/spinner and I have it works really good, however, I was displeased that the hose that comes with it doesn't work it does not fit or stay on the washer and does not fit my kitchen sink/bathroom sink/ or shower so I think I should get some kind of refund due to the fact that now I have to waste my time and go to a hardware store and buy another hose which is not right.

I love this panda washer/spinner. One thing that stands out is that u can continue to wash and use the spinner at the same time which I noticed during my research you can't do with other similar washer/spinner. This panda washes very well on the gentle cycle which I use for all my wash loads. Takes a little more time bcz u have to do more hands-on w/the washing & rinsing, etc. You have the options of how long you want to wash and how many rinses on every load and I love not having to settle on a automatic washer. Even tho a regular washer/dryer  would be great - but for reasons you can't have a regular one. I've had this for 4 mos now and it's doing great. It does all my wash except blankets, quilts, pillows and large similar items. Those I take to the laundromat. It sure is nice to be able to do laundry in your own apt and washer.

Saved my sanity off grid

We've lived off grid for the last 19 mo and have always struggled with laundry. I have 7 kids, 5 still at home and hubs and I. Keeping up with our dirty life by hand was a chore and the cost of hauling the laundry to town to our laundrymat was $30+ a week.... wasn't working well doing it by hand either.

We have a small solar system but live in northern mn... I decided not to try operating this washer on that alone as it was a pretty big draw powerwise off grid. I did however plug into our portable elec generator and was able to carry on.

I have to hand pump the water outside at the well and carry it in soooooo whoa lol I needed 15+ gals each cycle. Thats a lot of hauling! I can't attest to how it fills as I was the one filling it but when I turned it to wash..... WOW THE POWER! It washed my 12 large articles of clothes no prob. I could have fit more. And tbh I could have added another 5 gals of water for an even larger load. I also did 8 large bath towels with no problem :)

The spinner works fabulously. Spins it near dry. I hang my clothes indoors in the winter by the woodstove and I would say they are dry within two hrs or less. Very very very happy. Soooooooo dang happy!

I realize my review isn't typical use but if there are others out there like me with an off grid or non typical life style this is also a great option. The size is awesome too. Small enough to tuck away but big enough to handle

Absolutely perfect I have a family of 5. 3of them are children under the age of 13 so I do quite a bit a laundry and I absolutely love my panda washing machine I use it every week at least 4 to 6loads a week!  Only got a bigger one because I got a gift card from Amazon so I'm giving my old one which is the smaller one to my niece!  I have not had it for about a year!  What makes it even better is I can do the small and  medium blankets for my kids their jackets and jeans not to mention anything else I can fit !

Would have stayed at 5 stars, but the product broke after 6 months. Worked great, until it just stopped suddenly. Warranty is crap, you are responsible for shipping to them, AND shipping back to you...they may or may not cover what they fix and they won't tell you in advance whether the repair will be covered.

POS !!!!!  Would not have bought it !  Would have returned it if I had gotten to use it in time allowed for a return!  15 minutes to wash, that is a fantastic thing... but 15 days to rinse... that SUCKS !!!! if your clothes ever get rinsed !!! Eventually you end up taking them out and rinsing them by hand !!!  I have tried every possible way to rinse the clothes.  Fill with water, swish, drain, spin the clothes, back to tub, fill with water, swish, drain, spin, back to tub, fill with water, swish, drain, again and again and again, still, soap, soap, soap... and before I hear the comments about too much soap, this has happened with 1 teaspoon, yes, one teaspoon ! of soap.  it's as if there is a reservoir under the unit that holds back a certain amount of soapy water, so when you refill it, you already have soapy water.  so I suggest you only use it to wash small items that you do not mind rinsing out by hand. forget about rinsing out a large sheet, or a blanket, or especially a towel or something that holds soap in it's fibers.

LOVE THIS MACHINE!!!  Yes you do have to reload the water to rinse,  but the cleaning of the cloths is just as good as a normal size washer.  Having a regular plug makes it great to use in a small kitchen, where the larger size are not.  ABSOLUTELY  L O V E this machine.  Would be great for small loads, like baby cloths that mount up quite quick or those uniforms;  however it is made to wash those large loads as well .  ITS AMAZING Just AMAZING!!!

I received the 15lb unit today and I am stoked. We live in a small apartment and although we do have coin laundry available, getting quarters is a pain and... I just hate it. I tested this immediately.

I had no trouble at all with the hose, maybe people are using the wrong end? It popped right on and stayed there. It took very little soap to wash the load, which was an impressive amount of clothes. It's obviously much more manual than a traditional washer, you have to move the clothes from one side to the other between spin and wash cycles, but it got the job done in about half an hour.

I did learn my lesson about letting the hose sit on the floor while the machine is on, even though it wasn't in drain cycle. Don't do that! Oops 😂😂😂

Anyway, I'm very excited. No more skipping laundry just because I don't have quarters and no more hauling loads up and down two flights of stairs, and no more waiting for neighbors to come get their clothes. Definitely worth the money!

A few details: I live in NYC on a third floor walkup in a tiny 500 sq ft apartment.

- Its FAST but requires some work: The way it works is you fill up the laundry, add water/detergent and set the wash for 15 mins. After that, you flip a switch, and the panda automatically drains itself. You refill, and run a rinse cycle (also 15 mins). When it's done draining for the second time, you transfer the clothing into the centrifuge for 3- minute cycles (I do 2-3 centrifuges per load, depending on how much stuff you have in there). Is it a bit of a chore? Yes. But if you're looking into this you're not going to have a real machine, so this is absolutely as good as it gets.
- It's basically a giant, sturdy piece of plastic. I'm borderline emotional about it, but it is absolutely high quality, and very much designed to be simple and with the end user in mind.
- For what it does, it's surprisingly quiet (unless you load the spinner wrong - see cons).

Good quality filters, but the center hole is larger than the plunger stem on the Bodum 4 cup press I bought at Target.  It's not a serious problem if you first center the flat filter as it comes out of the package and carefully bend up the edges around the retainer plate,  It will hold that shape, and thereafter, inserting the retainer plate into the now-formed screen will center it correctly.  Once the plunger is securely screwed into the bottom plate, the screen will stay centered and coffee grounds will not seem around the oversized hole.  The edge of the screen is trimmed more neatly than the original screen that came with the coffee press, but it still could be done better.  The very edge of the screen should have a double fold so the sharp wires are hidden inside a hem, rather than protruding inside the screen where they can poke the user during cleaning.
